name: Romance and Pig-Butchering Investment Scams
description: Offenders build online trust over weeks or months, then steer the victim into sending money for an emergency or into a fake investment platform that shows fabricated gains. Funds typically flow through exchanges, mule accounts and offshore networks.

sources.text: FinCEN, Alert on prevalent virtual currency investment scam commonly known as pig butchering (2023)
FATF, Interpol and Egmont Group, Illicit Financial Flows from Cyber-enabled Fraud (2023)
UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)

exposure.rationale: Victim payments to exchanges and offshore accounts.
